Mentoring Follow-up Event

Workshops & Seminars

Event start time 11.11.2025 12:00

Event end time 11.11.2025 14:00

Add to calendar: ics Google

We hope your semester is going well. On Tuesday, November 11th, from 12:00 to 14:00 we will hold our follow-up event in StuZ (CAB F21).

There you will have the chance to catch up with your mentor or mentee and exchange tips and advice about the semester and student life in general.

If possible you should try to come together with your mentor or mentee, but don't be afraid to come alone if one of you can't come.

Cake and drinks are ready :)

The fine print

  • By participating you agree that pictures and videos can be taken of you that could be used for VIS-Purposes (VISIONEN, Instagram, etc)

  • By participating, you agree to adhere by the VIS Code of Conduct

  • Every participant is responsible for their own insurance

  • All statements are made without guarantee

  • In general, there are no refunds

Event organisers

Main event organiser Megan Marty

  • Olivia Furrer

Interested in consulting without losing touch with the technical side?

Time: 18.00 – 21.00
Location: Deloitte Prime 2, Pfingstweidstrasse 11, 8005 Zürich

Event start time 20.11.2025 12:15

Event end time 20.11.2025 13:00

Add to calendar: ics Google

Have you ever thought about your future impact on society as an engineer, scientist or in any other role? How about the responsibilities you might carry in the future? The "Dilemma of the Month" is a series of monthly, informal gatherings, which are designed to be an open space for you to explore, share and discuss your opinions and thoughts on a given topic with others. Everyone including non-CS and non-students is welcome to join :)

This month's edition will be on "Data as Currency: How much is your privacy worth?" Humanity creates tons of data each day. As computer science students we are heavily involved in if, why and how this data is collected, sold, processed and where it ends up being used. In this dilemma of the month, we want to invite you to join us for an interesting discussion on how working with data could and should look. We will talk about past and current political trends and real world scenarios but also invite you to our open and safe space to reflect on, share, and discuss your opinions on our pathway into the future.

Here's a sneak peek into possible questions¹ you can tinker with:

  • How much are you willing to sell your data for as a user of a service or product?
  • How much control should the state or other governing bodies exert on our data?
  • What are best practices for companies or researchers?

📅 When: Thursday, 20.11.2025 12:15-13:00²
📍 Where: CAB H52
🥪 Yes, we will provide lunch for you. Yes, it is free :D

¹ Remember, there is no correct answer to questions we ask.
² We will provide an open space for continued discussions after the official event and you are welcome to stay for as long as you want.

Organized with ❤️ by the "Ethics in CS" task force. You can find more information about our initiative here:

  • https://www.instagram.com/ethics_in_cs/

Overview

Once again, on Friday, 28th of November it is finally time for the smell of molten cheese and the clatter of caquelons wafting through the CAB building. So grab your fellow students and secure your place at FIGUGEGL, the fondue evening galore, to celebrate this Swiss tradition with us. Fondue sets will be given out to groups of four. If you do not find a group of four, that's no problem at all, because at the event itself there will be enough people to spontaneously form a group.

There will hopefully be enough food for all registered participants. However, to avoid crowding, we will divide the portions into two time slots. This should guarantee that people who come later will not be at a disadvantage and will also be served food.
Therefore, we ask you to indicate your preferred time slot when signing up. However, it might be possible that there will not be a seat available immediately upon arrival.

The event is sponsored by Siemens. Siemens AG is a German multinational technology conglomerate. It is focused on industrial automation, building automation, rail transport and health technology. Siemens is the largest engineering company in Europe, and holds the position of global market leader in industrial automation and industrial software.

An event of this size is simply not possible without motivated helpers. That's why we are looking for people to support us during the event. Hilti is globally recognized for its cutting-edge hardware solutions in the construction industry – but did you know we also innovate in software, AI, and robotics? Join us at ETH for an exclusive presentation by Hilti’s Research Department, where we’ll explore how computer science powers the future of construction technology. This session is tailored for students passionate about software engineering, AI, and embedded systems. You’ll gain insights into:

• Computer Vision & AI: Explore which clean code principles are used to develop intelligent systems that perceive and interpret the physical world – introduced by Emilia Szymanska, a Computer Vision research engineer.

• IoT & Wireless Technologies: Learn how the wireless protocol landscape is defining the future of IoT connectivity and localization – explained by Akis Mekikis, PhD, an IoT researcher.

• Robotics & Autonomy: Discover how sensor fusion, software architectures, and navigation enable the next generation of autonomous mobile robots – presented by Riccardo Balbi, a robotics engineer.

We’ll also talk about career opportunities at Hilti, especially in our research department, and share practical advice on how to stand out when applying with us. After the presentations, there will be a chance to connect with our engineers during an apero. Come for the talks, stay for the pizza!

# VIS x Hilti: Tech Talk
Workshops & Seminars
**Event start time 19.11.2025 18:15**
**Event end time 19.11.2025 19:45**
**Add to calendar:[ics](https://vis.ethz.ch/en/events/1007/ics/) [Google](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=VIS%20x%20Hilti:%20Tech%20Talk&amp&details=Come%20learn%20about%20how%20computer%20vision,%20AI%20and%20embedded%20systems%20power%20the%20future%20of%20construction%20technology&dates=20251119T181500/20251119T194500) **
Hilti is globally recognized for its cutting-edge hardware solutions in the construction industry – but did you know we also innovate in software, AI, and robotics? Join us at ETH for an exclusive presentation by Hilti’s Research Department, where we’ll explore how computer science powers the future of construction technology. This session is tailored for students passionate about software engineering, AI, and embedded systems. You’ll gain insights into:
• Computer Vision & AI: Explore which clean code principles are used to develop intelligent systems that perceive and interpret the physical world – introduced by Emilia Szymanska, a Computer Vision research engineer.
• IoT & Wireless Technologies: Learn how the wireless protocol landscape is defining the future of IoT connectivity and localization – explained by Akis Mekikis, PhD, an IoT researcher.
• Robotics & Autonomy: Discover how sensor fusion, software architectures, and navigation enable the next generation of autonomous mobile robots – presented by Riccardo Balbi, a robotics engineer.
We’ll also talk about career opportunities at Hilti, especially in our research department, and share practical advice on how to stand out when applying with us. After the presentations, there will be a chance to connect with our engineers during an apero. Come for the talks, stay for the pizza!
📍 Location: CAB G 51  
📅 Date: 19.11.2025  
🕕 Time: 18:15 – 19:45
### The fine print
  * By participating you agree that pictures and videos can be taken of you that could be used for VIS-Purposes (VISIONEN, Instagram, etc)
  * By participating, you agree to adhere by the [VIS Code of Conduct](https://cdn.vis.ethz.ch/code-of-conduct)
  * Every participant is responsible for their own insurance
  * All statements are made without guarantee
  * In general, there are no refunds
